sidebar.delete_database_question:
Remove '{name}' from your account?
Only the saved connection goes, and the logins made in the database for the people you shared it with: they lose access. Nothing else in the database is touched.
sidebar.delete_table_question: Are you sure you want to delete '{name}'?
sidebar.owner_only_drop: Only the owner of a shared database can drop its tables.
sidebar.drop_view_question:
Drop '{name}' from the database?
It is dropped when you click {run_query}.
sidebar.drop_table_question:
Drop '{name}' and all its rows from the database?
It is dropped when you click {run_query}.
